sloka: अवरुह्य जगाम आशु वेला वनम् अनुत्तमम् ।रामो रमयताम् श्रेष्ठः ससुग्रीवः सलक्ष्मणः ॥६-४-९८॥।।
transliteration: avaruhya jagāma āśu velā vanam anuttamam ।rāmo ramayatām śreṣṭhaḥ sasugrīvaḥ salakṣmaṇaḥ ॥6-4-98॥।।

translations.english: Rama, who causes delight to others, got down (the mountain) along with Lakshmana and Sugriva and soon reached the wood on the sea coast.
